The machine is located in a warehouse or shop environment.
A watermark 'KENDO ENTERPRISES' is visible across the center of the image.

risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge and a photo of the toner level on the printer's control panel.

risks.risk: The machine may have a high page count or mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A photo of a recent print job showing the total page count.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high page count

Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
